links.outcome: Response accuracy with versus without self-directed retrieval from online and offline sources
links.effect: Authors report substantial improvements in response accuracy when the model was equipped with self-directed information retrieval; no numbers given in the abstract.
links.quote: By equipping the model with self-directed information retrieval from reliable online and offline sources, we observed substantial improvements in the accuracy of its responses.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning an LLM on real patient-doctor dialogues to improve medical advice

screen.reason: The paper develops ChatDoctor and specifically evaluates incorporating a self-directed information retrieval mechanism (external knowledge grounding) to improve response accuracy.
